before: Legacy checkbox form fields could not be toggled, and content-control value pop-ups were engine-only.
after: A new setLegacyCheckbox op rewrites w:checked, and pop-ups and widgets are host-composable; shared document state keeps the same OOXML shape.
reason: The new op reduces to existing canonical tree primitives on the field's w:checkBox element, which the journal already replicates, so released participants read the resulting state unchanged. Pop-up and widget changes are local chrome and never enter shared updates.
